name: GTA 6 delay history
short_description: Grand Theft Auto VI was delayed twice: from an original fall 2025 target to 26 May 2026, then to the current 19 November 2026 date.
long_description: Rockstar Games originally targeted a fall 2025 release for Grand Theft Auto VI. In 2025 the game was delayed to 26 May 2026. A second delay, announced around 6 November 2025, pushed the release a further six months to Thursday, 19 November 2026, the date that stands as of this record. Rockstar's public statement cited the need for additional polish, saying it was sorry for adding time to an already long wait but that the extra months would let it finish the game to the standard players expect.
